text: {"lessons":["My account rose over these periods, but that alone does not show which trades helped; I should assess decisions over time against a consistent plan, not recent returns.","Buying more of C and E and later selling some changed my exposure, so I should set position-size and diversification limits before placing trades.","I should avoid trading just because prices have moved or I check the account often; each buy, sell, or hold should have a clear reason tied to my long-term apartment goal."]}
